prompt.String:
You are the single focused OpenAI reviewer for the already-published implementation of docs/iterations/063-add-custom-group-members/plan.md.

Review the plan, the collected evidence, the current tree, and `8b938c7d1d0838c3cfd47fb7b236fae084db193d..HEAD`. Implementation has already passed its delivery gates and reached `main`; this healer is not an acceptance gate. Do not edit files, do not reinterpret provider failure as a verdict, and do not request acceptance-feature edits.

Read applicable ADRs and project references, especially `docs/reference/domain-driven-design.md`, `docs/reference/cqrs.md`, `docs/reference/event-sourcing.md`, and `docs/reference/responsibility-driven-design.md`. Preserve factual evidence: name files, symbols, tests, ADRs, and concrete risks.

Classify the whole review into exactly one disposition:

- `clean`: no actionable finding. This completes without rerunning the full gate.
- `bounded_heal`: one small, low-risk code/config/test/refactoring correction that preserves existing product behaviour and architecture. It can receive at most one automatic repair pass.
- `record`: a factual, non-urgent code-health finding worth preserving in `docs/code-health.md`, but no code/config/test change now.
- `consequential`: requires Matt's judgement. This includes product behaviour, ADR or architecture decisions, migrations or production data, security/privacy, broad cross-cutting work, a behavioural gap, or any repeated/no-progress repair concern. When uncertain between bounded and consequential, choose consequential.

Do not split a consequential finding into a supposedly bounded fix. Multiple independent findings that cannot be safely handled by one bounded pass are consequential. Historical synthesis omissions are evidence that every supported finding must remain visible in your report.

Return concise Markdown containing: disposition, confidence, factual evidence, why the classification threshold applies, proposed next action, and focused checks (if bounded). End with exactly one routing JSON object:

```json
{"context_updates":{"review_disposition":"clean","review_finding_ids":[],"review_evidence":"concise factual evidence"}}
```

`review_disposition` must be exactly `clean`, `bounded_heal`, `record`, or `consequential`. Use stable short IDs for findings. The JSON must be the final response content.

prompt.String:
Apply one bounded healing pass for the focused review of docs/iterations/063-add-custom-group-members/plan.md.

Use only the preceding review's factual evidence. Make the smallest low-risk code/config/test change that preserves existing product behaviour and architecture. Do not make product decisions, ADR/architecture changes, migrations/production-data changes, security/privacy policy changes, broad cross-cutting changes, or acceptance-feature changes.

Do not commit or push. Do not spawn subagents. Run only focused checks directly related to the change. Do not run `dev check`, `dev check --quick`, `dev ci`, or another full suite here; the workflow owns the exact-state full gate. Do not launch background/detached commands.

There is only one automatic repair pass. If the finding cannot be safely fixed, is already fixed, repeats, or would produce no meaningful repository diff, leave clear factual evidence; the deterministic progress check will escalate to Matt rather than loop.

Summarize the finding-to-change mapping, files changed, focused checks and remaining risk.

spec.graph_source:
digraph CodeReview {
    graph [
        goal="Review the already-published implementation of {{ inputs.plan_path }} and heal only bounded code-health issues without changing delivery status",
        default_fidelity="summary:high",
        max_node_visits=40,
        model_stylesheet="
            * { provider: openai; model: gpt-5.6-sol; reasoning_effort: high; }
            #focused_reviewer { provider: openai; model: gpt-5.6-terra; reasoning_effort: high; }
            #read_plan { reasoning_effort: low; }
            #record_code_health { reasoning_effort: high; }
            #final_summary { reasoning_effort: low; }
        "
    ]
    rankdir=LR

    start [shape=Mdiamond, label="Start"]
    exit [shape=Msquare, label="Exit"]

    read_plan [
        label="Read Iteration Plan",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="PLAN_PATH='{{ inputs.plan_path }}'\nif [ ! -f \"$PLAN_PATH\" ]; then exit 1; fi\nprintf 'PLAN_PATH=%s\\n\\n' \"$PLAN_PATH\"\nsed -n '1,320p' \"$PLAN_PATH\""
    ]
    read_failed [label="Fail: Plan Missing", shape=parallelogram, script="echo 'Code review could not read the plan. The already-published implementation remains successful.' >&2\nexit 1"]

    preflight_sandbox [
        label="Preflight Code-review Sandbox",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/preflight_sandbox.sh '{{ inputs.candidate_sha }}'",
        timeout="600s"
    ]
    preflight_failed [label="Fail: Sandbox Preflight", shape=parallelogram, script="echo 'Code-review infrastructure preflight failed. Implementation publication is unchanged; inspect this run and retry the healer.' >&2\nexit 1"]

    collect_implementation_evidence [
        label="Collect Published Implementation Evidence",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/collect_implementation_evidence.sh '{{ inputs.base_sha }}'",
        timeout="120s"
    ]
    collect_evidence_failed [label="Fail: Evidence Collection", shape=parallelogram, script="echo 'Code review could not collect published implementation evidence. Implementation publication is unchanged.' >&2\nexit 1"]

    focused_reviewer [
        label="Focused OpenAI Code Reviewer",
        shape=tab,
        output_schema="routing",
        prompt="@prompts/review.md",
        retry_policy="patient"
    ]
    reviewer_unavailable [label="Fail: Reviewer Unavailable", shape=parallelogram, script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/record_observability.sh provider_failure false false\necho 'The focused reviewer failed. No acceptance or rejection is implied; implementation publication remains successful.' >&2\nexit 1"]

    disposition [shape=diamond, label="Review disposition"]

    snapshot_before_heal [
        label="Snapshot Before Bounded Heal",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="set -eu\nmkdir -p .fabro/tmp\nbefore_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$before_head\" > .fabro/tmp/review-repair-before-head.txt\ngit diff --binary \"$before_head\" > .fabro/tmp/review-repair-before.patch\nprintf 'Bounded-heal baseline captured at %s.\\n' \"$before_head\""
    ]
    apply_bounded_heal [
        label="Apply One Bounded Heal",
        shape=box,
        prompt="@prompts/apply_review_fixes.md",
        timeout="2400s"
    ]
    verify_heal_progress [
        label="Verify Heal Progress",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/verify_review_repair.sh"
    ]
    dev_check [
        label="Exact-state Dev Check",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="PATH=\"$PWD/bin:$PATH\" dev check",
        timeout="3600s"
    ]

    record_code_health [
        label="Record Non-urgent Finding",
        shape=box,
        fidelity="truncate",
        output_schema="routing",
        prompt="@prompts/record_code_health.md"
    ]
    code_health_recording_failed [label="Fail: Code-health Recording", shape=parallelogram, script="echo 'Code-health recording failed. The finding remains in this run; implementation publication remains successful.' >&2\nexit 1"]

    consequential_context [
        label="Preserve Consequential Finding Context",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/record_observability.sh consequential true false\necho 'Consequential finding requires Matt: product behaviour, ADR/architecture, migration/production data, security/privacy, broad cross-cutting work, or repeated/no-progress repair. Review the preceding reviewer and repair evidence before answering.'"
    ]
    consequential_gate [
        label="Matt: choose a safe disposition for the consequential finding (review preceding evidence)",
        shape=hexagon,
        question_type="multiple_choice"
    ]
    prepare_followup [
        label="Prepare Human-directed Follow-up Record",
        shape=box,
        output_schema="routing",
        prompt="@prompts/record_code_health.md"
    ]

    final_artifact_gate [
        label="Final Healer Artifact Gate",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/final_artifact_gate.sh '{{ inputs.plan_path }}' '{{ inputs.base_sha }}'"
    ]
    artifact_failed [label="Fail: Final Artifact Gate", shape=parallelogram, script="echo 'Healer artifact policy failed; nothing is allowed to alter the successful delivery result.' >&2\nexit 1"]
    publish_followup [
        label="Publish Separate Follow-up Commit",
        shape=parallelogram,
        script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/publish_polish_to_main.sh '{{ inputs.plan_path }}'",
        timeout="3600s"
    ]
    publish_failed [label="Fail: Follow-up Publication", shape=parallelogram, script="echo 'Follow-up publication failed. Inspect the run/checkpoint/rescue evidence; implementation is still delivered.' >&2\nexit 1"]

    observe_clean [label="Observe Clean Review", shape=parallelogram, script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/record_observability.sh clean false false"]
    observe_record [label="Observe Recorded Finding", shape=parallelogram, script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/record_observability.sh record false false"]
    observe_heal [label="Observe Published Heal", shape=parallelogram, script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/record_observability.sh bounded_heal false true"]
    observe_dismiss [label="Observe Human Dismissal", shape=parallelogram, script="bash .fabro/workflows/code-review/scripts/record_observability.sh dismissed true false"]

    final_summary [label="Final Code-review Summary", shape=tab, prompt="@prompts/final_summary.md", goal_gate=true]

    start -> read_plan
    read_plan -> preflight_sandbox [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    read_plan -> read_failed
    read_failed -> exit
    preflight_sandbox -> collect_implementation_evidence [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    preflight_sandbox -> preflight_failed
    preflight_failed -> exit
    collect_implementation_evidence -> focused_reviewer [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    collect_implementation_evidence -> collect_evidence_failed
    collect_evidence_failed -> exit
    focused_reviewer -> disposition [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    focused_reviewer -> reviewer_unavailable
    reviewer_unavailable -> exit

    disposition -> observe_clean [label="Clean", condition="context.review_disposition=clean"]
    disposition -> snapshot_before_heal [label="Bounded heal", condition="context.review_disposition=bounded_heal"]
    disposition -> record_code_health [label="Record", condition="context.review_disposition=record"]
    disposition -> consequential_context [label="Consequential or invalid classification"]

    snapshot_before_heal -> apply_bounded_heal
    apply_bounded_heal -> verify_heal_progress
    verify_heal_progress -> dev_check [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    verify_heal_progress -> consequential_context [label="No progress; escalate"]
    dev_check -> final_artifact_gate [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    dev_check -> consequential_context [label="Validation failed; escalate"]

    record_code_health -> final_artifact_gate [condition="context.code_health_recording_ok=true"]
    record_code_health -> code_health_recording_failed
    code_health_recording_failed -> exit
    prepare_followup -> final_artifact_gate [condition="context.code_health_recording_ok=true"]
    prepare_followup -> code_health_recording_failed

    consequential_context -> consequential_gate
    consequential_gate -> record_code_health [label="[R] Record / defer"]
    consequential_gate -> prepare_followup [label="[P] Prepare / attempt a separately approved follow-up"]
    consequential_gate -> observe_dismiss [label="[D] Dismiss with rationale"]
    consequential_gate -> prepare_followup [freeform=true]

    final_artifact_gate -> publish_followup [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    final_artifact_gate -> artifact_failed
    artifact_failed -> exit
    publish_followup -> observe_heal [condition="outcome=succeeded && context.review_disposition=bounded_heal"]
    publish_followup -> observe_record [condition="outcome=succeeded"]
    publish_followup -> publish_failed
    publish_failed -> exit

    observe_clean -> final_summary
    observe_record -> final_summary
    observe_heal -> final_summary
    observe_dismiss -> final_summary
    final_summary -> exit
}
